book.title: PAOT TE KONĨN XOP PU KAX'ÃMI' I

content: Kunnix te putpu' hi'
'Ãte xa hãm'ãpak max'ax 'ãktux, ka' xaxok. 'Ãxop te hãm'ãpak, yã 'ãkuxa mãm ka'ok hõmã xix hõnhã'.
Yã hãm'ãpak max'ax hã 'ãxop kuxa tup, tu' mãm ka'ok 'ãmõ kuma 'ãmõg. 'Ok pe 'ãkuxa te yã hitop hã' mãm ka'ok.
Topa te 'ã hãm'ãktux, ha 'ãte xa' xuktux, yã hãm'ãktux xe'e', hu: Kunnix xok, yũmũg pupi' xok, yũmũ'ãte hãpkummuk mĩy pax ha' xok, ha Topa yõg tappet te' xuktux,
ha nõ hãpkot, ha 'ãmnĩy 3 nõg, 'ĩhã' putpu' hi', ha Topa yõg tappet te' xuktux,
ha Pet te Kunnix pẽnãhã', hak-nãy tu mõ'pok xop te 12 te' pẽnãhã',
hak-nãy tu tikmũ'ũn te 500 te' pẽnãhã', nõm xop kuxa mãm ka'ok te 500 te' pẽnãhã'. Tikmũ'ũn 'ũm yã' pip, pãyã' yãg xakix hittap.
Hak-nãy tu Tiak te' pẽnãhã', hak-nãy tu mõ'pok xop xohix te' pẽnãhã'.
Ha ka'ax hã 'ãte Kunnix pẽnãhã', 'ũka'ax hãk kuxa te yũmũg xuxyã kopa' yũm ka'ok.
Yã 'ãte mõ'pok xop hãk ka'ax, tuk kutõgnãg, huk xax te kutuk, tu yãyhãhup, pãyã Yeyox te nũgkutnãhã 'ũka'ax hã. Hõmã 'ãte kuxa mãm ka'ok xop xũygãhã', huk xax te kutuk.
Pa Topa te 'ã hãmmaxnãhã', huk mõgkutnãhã, ha 'ãte hãpxopmãhã punethok, ha mõ'pok xop nõy hãpxopmã kutõgnãg, pak puxet'ah, yã Topa tek ka'ogãhã', 'ũyĩy hãpxopmã ka'ok.
Yĩy 'ãtep yũmmũg putup'ah, 'ok pek hãm, 'ok pe yãk nõy hãm, pak mũg xohix te hãm'ãpak max'ax 'ãktux, ha 'ãkuxa mãm ka'ok hãm'ãktux'ax kopah.
Yũmũ'ãte putpuk hip-tup
Hak mũ'ãte Kunnix te putpu hi'ax 'ãktux. Tep te xĩy 'ãxop 'ũm te: “Yũmũg yog xakix xop te putpu hip-tup 'ohnãg,” kaxĩy.
Pax pu' xakix xop putpu tu hi hok, puxix Kunnix 'a putpu hi'ah kamah.
Pax pu Kunnix putpu tu hi hok, kopxik mũg hitop hã hãm'ãpak max'ax 'ãktux, ha yã 'ãkuxa kama 'ũhitop hã' mãm.
Kamah: Kunnix putpu tu hi hok, kopxik mũg yã' koit, 'ihã Kunnix putpu hi'ax 'ãktux. Pax pu' xakix xop putpu tu hi hok, puxix Topa yã Kunnix putpu hĩnnã hok kamah.
Pax pu' xakix xop putpu tu' hi hok, puxix Kunnix putpu tu hi hok.
Pax pu Kunnix putpu tu hi hok, puxix 'ãkuxa hitop hã' mãm ka'ok Kunnix kopah, ha 'ãkuxa tup 'ohnãg. Yã' kummuhnãg.
Pax pu' xakix xop kuxa hitop tu' mãm, tu Topa yõg putat hã' mõg hok, puxix tu Topa hãptox hã' pi nõmhã'.
Pax hãm tup-xet hã yũmũ 'ãte Kunnix hip, xix pexkox hã yũmũg mõg hok, puxix yũmũg kuxa xakix putũmnãg, yũmũg hittup 'ohnãg tu', ha' kuxa mãm hok xop tu hittup.
Pãyã Kunnix te putpu hi xe'ẽgnãg, 'ãte hãpxe'e 'ãktux, yĩ' xakix xop te putpu' hip-tup kamah.
Tik puxet 'Anão te hãpkummuk mĩy, yĩy yã' xohix xakix, hã kaxĩy tik puxet nõy te' putpu' hĩnnãhã'.
'Ũxohix xakix mõnãyxop te mãxap 'Anão hah, hã kaxĩy 'ũxohix te putpu' hip-tup, Kunnix hãh. Yã Kunnix te' putpu' hĩnnãp-tup.
Tu ta putpu' hi hãmãxap, hak-nãy tu Kunnix yõg tikmũ'ũn hip-tup, 'ĩhã Kunnix putpu' nũn.
Yã hãmyãxatamuk ka'ax xohix yõg xox putox, ha Kunnix te hãpkummuk xop yõg xexka xop xohix nõãp-tup, xi' xat'ax kummuk xop xohix nõãp-tup, nũy Topa yũmũg Tak ha' nũnnã', puyĩy Topa pu' yĩpkox pi'.
Ha Kunnix te' xat putup, tu mõktu Topa te' gãyxop kuxyã', tu mõktu hãmgãy xop xohix kuxyãhã', tuk-tok Kunnix ha' nũnnãp-tup, pu tu' nõa'.
Ha' ka'ax hã Topa te' xat putup, puyĩy tikmũ'ũn xakix hok,
yĩy Topa yõg tappet te: “Topa te' xexka xop xohix nũnnãhã', pu tu' yĩpkox pi',” kaxĩy. Pãyã Topa mũn xexka', tu Kunnix ha' nũnnã'ax hãmgãy xop yõg xexka xop,
tu' kuxyãhã', puxik-tok te yãy Tak pu' yĩpkox xihip, pu tu' xat, tu' hep xop xohix xat'ax, 'ũxexka xe'ẽgnãg tu'.
Tikmũ'ũn 'ũm te' nõy xok tup-tox pix, yĩy 'ãte 'ãyĩkopit, hu: Teptu xatep-tox pix 'ãxape xok pupi', 'ĩhã xate' putpu' hi'ax 'ãktux hok?
Xik mũ'ãg. Tep tuk mũg xũy, xik mũg xakix putũmnãg, nũy hãm'ãpak max'ax 'ãktux?
'Ũkxape xop, 'ãte xa hãm'ãktux, tu hãpxe'e 'ãktux. 'Ãmnĩy xohix 'ĩhãk xok putũmnãg. 'Ãte xa hãpxe'e 'ãktux. 'Ãxop te hãpxopmã max, yĩk hittup, yã yũmũg kuxap-xet yũmũg xuxyã Yeyox Kunnix kuxa mũtik.

Hõmãk xip nũnte kõmẽn 'Epex tu', ha' gãy xop te hãmgãy putuk, tuk putex putup, 'ãte hãm'ãpak max 'ãktux hah. Pax 'ãte hãm'ãktux, puyĩy tikmũ'ũn 'ũgmax 'ãktux, kopxi' hitop hã hãm'ãktux. Pax pu' xakix xop putpu tu hi hok, kopxix max yũmũg hãpxopmã hãmpuknõg xop putuk, ha: “'Ãpu yũmũg xit, xix xo'op. Yã hãptup 'ĩhã yũmũg xakix,” kaxĩy. Yã' hitop hã hãpxopmãhã'.
Yãy hã mõ'ãmã hok. Tik kummuk mũtik 'ãmõg, hu ta 'ãkummuk kamah.
'Ãpu hãpxopmã kummuk kuxyã', tu Topa yõg putat hã 'ãmõg putpu'. 'Ãxop 'ũm te Topa yũmmũg 'ohnãg. 'Ãte xa' xuktux nũy xa' hupmã'.
Yũmũg yĩn te putpu' hip-tup
Pa tikmũ'ũn 'ũm xek yĩkopit, hu: “Tep te xĩy 'ũxakix xop putpu hip-tup?” kaxĩy. “'Ũyĩn te xĩy?” kaxĩy.
'Ãxop te hãmyũmmũg 'ohnãg! 'Ãxop te hãpxop xap xok 'ĩhã' xok, pu tu' xokax.
Ha' xap, 'ok pe xuxnãg xetox xap, 'ok pe mĩxux xap nõy, 'ũxap mũn 'ap mĩxux yĩnmũn'ah.
Ha Topa te hãpxop xap xohix yãyhã mĩxux, yã Topa tep-tup.
Ha' hi'ax xop xohix punethok. Yã tikmũ'ũn yĩn puxet, xix xokxop yĩn yã' nõy, xix putuxnãg xop yĩn yã' nõy, xix mãm xop yĩn yã' nõy.
Ha pexkox yõg xop yĩn yã' nõy, xix hãm xexka yõg xop yĩn yã' nõy. Ha' xohix max, pãyã hãmmax nõy. 'Ap nõy putuk'ah.
Mãyõn max, tu hãptupmãhã', ha mãyõnhex max, tu 'ãmnĩy tupmãhã', ha mãyõnnãg xop xohix max kamah, tu hãptupmã nõy. 'Ap nõy putuk'ah.
Ha kaxĩy 'ũxakix xop te putpu hip-tup. 'Ũyĩn yã hahãm yõg, ha nõ hãpkot, 'ũkummuk tu', yã' xok xe'e'. Pa putpu' hi, 'ĩhã' yĩn tup, tu yĩn ka'ok, tu yĩn max, 'a xep xok putup'ah.
Putpu' hi, 'ihã yã pexkox yõg yĩn. 'Ũyĩn hittap yã hãm yõg, ha' yĩn tup pexkox yõg.
Yĩy Topa yõg tappet te: “Tik te mãxap 'ãxet'ax 'Anão, ha Topa te' hĩnnãhã',” kaxĩy. Pa 'Anão nõy 'ãxet'ax Kunnix, tu hãpxohix hĩnnãhã'.
Tu hãm yõg yĩn mĩy hãmãxap, nũy kunãy tu pexkox yõg yĩn mĩy.
Ha 'Anão te mãxap mĩy, 'ĩhã hãpkõnõn hã' mĩy, pa 'Anão nõy te pexkox tu' nũn.
Hãm xexka yõg xop te hãm yõg 'Anão putuk, ha pexkox yõg xop te 'Anão nõy putuk, nõm te pexkox tu' nũn.
Yũmũ'ãte hãm yõg tik putuk nõmhã, pãyã tik nõy te pexkox tu' nũn, ha yũmũ'ãte Kunnix putuk putup.
'Ũkxape xop, 'ãte xa hãmyũmmũgãp-tup, hu: Tikmũ'ũn yĩn yã hãm yõg, ha' yĩn xi' hep 'ãta hã' mĩy, yĩy Topa pẽnã hok pexkox kopah, tu pexkox yõg hãpxop pop hok kamah.
'Ũg 'ãpax, nũy hãm'ãktux xe'e 'ãpax. 'Ap xohix xakip-tup'ah. pãyã yũmũg yãyhãp-tup pexkox yõg tikmũ'ũn,

hãpxip 'ohnãg 'ĩhã', tikmũ'ũn pa xax te kutãgnãg, 'ĩhã yũmũg yãyhã pexkox yõg tikmũ'ũn, 'ĩhã mĩxux xop tut kãyãp-tup. Ha' xakix xop te putpu hip-tup, 'ũyĩn yã pexkox yõg yĩn, tu putpu' hip-tup, ha yũmũ'ãte yãyhãp-tup kamah.
Yã Topa te hãm yõg yĩn xit putup, nũy pexkox yõg yĩn hã yũmũg mõ'tat 'ũyãnãn tu', pu tu xakix'ax xop yãyhã xakix hok xop,

Ha pexkox yõg yĩn hã mõ yũmũg tat putup, 'ũyĩy yũmũg xakix hok, yã Topa te' xat putup, nũy yũmũg xakix kuxyã', 'ũyĩy yũmũg hi xe'ẽgnãg mõ kumak mog. Yã Topa yõg tappet te: “Topa te' xat hok pu tikmũ'ũn xep xakix hok, yĩy Topa te' xũy'ax kuxyã kamah, Topa mũn ka'ok xe'ẽgnãg tu'.”
Yã tikmũ'ũn xohix te hãpkummuk mĩy, tu' xat'ax pu' yĩpkox 'ohnãg, hu' xohix xũy, hu' xohix xakix.
Pa yũmũ'ãte Topa pu hãm'ãktux, tu: “'Ãmax Topah. Xatek mũ ka'ogãhã', 'ũyĩg mũg xakix hok, yãk mũg xuxyã Yeyox Kunnix tek mũg hĩnnã xe'ẽgnãg,” kaxĩy.
Yĩy Topa yõg putat hã 'ãmõy kuma 'ãmõg. Topa pu hãpxopmã max, yã yũmũg xuxyã te xa pagop-tup, 'ãxop te' yũmmũg.
